judgeRationales.rationale: Both responses are accurate, complete, and cover all four rubric criteria correctly. They are very similar in quality. judgeRationales.scenarioName: Set up trusted publishing for a new NuGet library
judgeRationales.rationale: Both correctly recognized the workspace lacked the actual repo.
